mapper.select:
select c.id,c.`name`,c.code,c.category_id,c.brand,c.model,c.goods_code,c.unit,c.quality_period, c.stock_max,c.stock_min,c.use_limit,c.stock,c.amount, IFNULL( ss.num,0) - COALESCE ( ss.occupy_num, 0 ) as storeNum, ss.position, ss.store_id, IFNULL(ss.amount,0) as storeAmount, c.file_ids, ss.avg_price from consumable_store_stock ss left join consumable c on ss.consumable_id = c.id where ss.deleted = 0 and c.`status`='NO_DELETE'
and ss.store_id = #{param.storeId}
and c.category_id = #{param.categoryId}
and (c.name like concat("%",#{param.keyword},"%") or c.code like concat("%",#{param.keyword},"%"))
and stock > stock_max
and stock > stock_min
order by c.stock

SELECT sum( a.amount ) AS `value`, sum(num) as num FROM consumable_store_stock a inner join consumable b on a.consumable_id=b.id
and b.name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')
and stock > stock_max
and stock < stock_min

SELECT sum(num - COALESCE ( occupy_num, 0 )) FROM `consumable_store_stock`
consumable_id =#{consumableId}
select a.consumable_id, a.num from consumable_store_stock a inner join consumable b on a.consumable_id = b.id where b.`status` = 'NO_DELETE' and a.store_id = #{storeId}
